headline: Lykos and Godcrofts Mark Renewed Front-Line Activity
war_summary: The latest ledger shows renewed movement at Lykos Isle and Godcrofts, both quiet in the previous edition’s latest window: each recorded two strategic-base events in the past two hours. Lykos remains closely divided, with four Warden and three Colonial bases, while Godcrofts holds seven Warden bases, one Colonial base, and one neutral site. Deadlands remains the war’s busiest recorded ownership front, with 14 events over 24 hours and two in six, though none in the latest two-hour watch; its bases stand four Warden to seven Colonial. Farranac Coast has likewise gone quiet in the latest two hours after three events in six and six in 24, retaining a nine-to-two Colonial lead. Fisherman’s Row shows no recent movement but remains historically active, with 14 events in the day and an eight-to-one Warden advantage. Beyond the event ledgers, Marban Hollow is drawing sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments, while Linn’s Mercy reports accelerating casualties; neither has logged a base event in 24 hours.
